name: Avatar of Death
senses: darkvision 60 ft., truesight 60 ft., passive Perception 13
languages: all languages known to its summoner

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: Half the hit point maximum of its summoner. Set this when it joins the fight.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Turning Immunity
traits.desc: The avatar is immune to features that turn undead.

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.desc: The avatar sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 10 (Medium or smaller), 20 (Large), 40 (Huge). Summoned by Animate Objects; its Proficiency Bonus equals yours.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: Force damage equal to 1d4 + 3 (Medium or smaller), 2d6 + 3 + your spellcasting ability modifier (Large), or 2d12 + 3 + your spellcasting ability modifier (Huge).

name: Otherworldly Steed
acNote: 10 + 1 per spell level; shown for a level 2 spell

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell's level). Shown for a level 2 spell. Summoned by Find Steed; its Proficiency Bonus equals yours.

traits.name: Life Bond
traits.desc: When you regain Hit Points from a level 1+ spell, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you're within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Otherworldly Slam
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 plus the spell's level of Radiant (Celestial), Psychic (Fey), or Necrotic (Fiend) damage.

actions.name: Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest) (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, one creature within 60 feet the steed can see. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

actions.name: Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest) (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: The steed teleports, along with its rider, to an unoccupied space of your choice up to 60 feet away from itself.

actions.name: Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest) (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: One creature within 5 feet of the steed regains a number of Hit Points equal to 2d8 plus the spell's level.

name: Giant Insect
acNote: 11 + the spell's level; shown for a level 4 spell
speed: 40 ft., climb 40 ft., fly 40 ft. (Wasp only)

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 30 + 10 for each spell level above 4. Summoned by Giant Insect; its Proficiency Bonus equals yours.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.desc: The insect can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The insect makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

actions.name: Poison Jab
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft. Hit: 1d6 + 3 plus the spell's level Piercing damage plus 1d4 Poison damage.

actions.name: Web Bolt (Spider Only)
actions.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, range 60 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 3 plus the spell's level Bludgeoning damage, and the target's Speed is reduced to 0 until the start of the insect's next turn.

actions.name: Venomous Spew (Centipede Only) (Bonus Action)
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: Your spell save DC, one creature the insect can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the insect's next turn.

name: Draconic Spirit
acNote: 14 + the spell's level; shown for a level 5 spell
senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 12
languages: Draconic, understands the languages you know

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 50 + 10 for each spell level above 5. Summoned by Summon Dragon; its Proficiency Bonus equals yours.

traits.name: Shared Resistances
traits.desc: When you summon the spirit, choose one of its Resistances. You have Resistance to the chosen damage type until the spell ends.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The spirit makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half the spell's level (round down), and it uses Breath Weapon.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 feet. Hit: 1d6 + 4 + the spell's level Piercing damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 2d6 damage of a type this spirit has Resistance to (your choice when you cast the spell). Success: Half damage.

name: Avatar of Death
languages: all languages known to its summoner

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: Half the HP maximum of its summoner. Set this when it joins the fight. Its Proficiency Bonus equals its summoner's.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The avatar can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The avatar makes a number of Reaping Scythe attacks equal to half the summoner's Proficiency Bonus (rounded up).

actions.name: Reaping Scythe
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: Automatic hit, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Necrotic damage.
